content: <thought>Using the ESI‑MS data, the most intense ion is at m/z 276.0666, which corresponds to [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the proton mass gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈275.059 Da. A formula that matches this mass within a few ppm and gives an integer double‑bond equivalent is C₁₃H₉NO₆ (exact mass 275.04299 Da, ~16 ppm error, DBE = 10). This fits the observed isotopic pattern (≈16 % M+1 intensity for ~13 carbons). Therefore the molecular formula is C13H9O6N.
